about_page.title: About The Bar People
about_page.body:
Founded in 2014, The Bar People started with a simple idea: every event deserves a brilliant bar experience — without the hassle. What began as one person, one van, and a lot of determination has grown into London's go-to mobile bar hire company, delivering 850+ events and counting.

We've served cocktails at Porsche launches, poured pints at charity galas, and mixed margaritas at hundreds of weddings. From a 50-person birthday to a 500-guest corporate bash, we bring the same energy, professionalism, and love for what we do.

Our modular bar systems are designed and built in-house — any size, any colour, indoor or outdoor. Our bartenders are experienced, friendly, and always professional. And our all-inclusive packages mean you don't have to think about anything except enjoying the night.

privacy_page.title: Privacy Policy
privacy_page.intro: Plain English, no surprises. Last updated July 2026.

sections.heading: Who we are
sections.body: The Bar People Ltd (company no. 12161824) provides mobile bar hire, bar staff and event services across the UK. This policy explains how we handle personal information you share with us through this website, by email or by phone.

sections.heading: What we collect and why
sections.body:
When you send an enquiry or request a quote we collect your name, contact details (email and/or phone), your event date and details, and anything you choose to tell us in your message. We use this solely to respond to your enquiry, prepare your quote and deliver your event.

We do not sell or rent your information to anyone, and we do not use it for third-party advertising.

sections.heading: Where it goes
sections.body: Enquiries are stored securely in our booking system so the team can manage your event. Emails live in our business mailboxes. We use trusted service providers (website hosting and our booking platform) to process this data on our behalf.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
sections.body: We keep enquiry and booking records for as long as needed to run your event and meet our legal obligations (for example, accounting records). If you never book with us, you can ask us to delete your enquiry at any time.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You can ask us at any time what information we hold about you, ask us to correct it, or ask us to delete it. Email jake@thebarpeople.co.uk and we will sort it promptly.

sections.heading: Cookies
sections.body: This website does not use advertising or tracking cookies. Our hosting provider may collect basic, anonymous analytics (such as page views) to keep the site running well.

privacy_page.seo_description: How The Bar People collects, uses and protects your personal information.

terms_page.title: Terms of Service
terms_page.intro: The short, honest version. Your written quote carries the specifics.

sections.heading: Quotes & bookings
sections.body: Website prices and instant estimates are a guide, not a contract — every event is different, and your final quote is confirmed in writing before anything is booked. A booking is confirmed once you accept your quote and pay any agreed deposit.

sections.heading: Payments
sections.body: Deposits secure your date. The balance is due before or on the event date as set out in your quote. Cash bar arrangements (where guests pay) are agreed in writing beforehand, including any minimum-spend terms.

sections.heading: Cancellations & changes
sections.body: Plans change — tell us as early as you can. Cancellation terms (including whether your deposit is refundable) are set out in your quote. Where we can move your booking to a new date instead, we will always try to.

sections.heading: Alcohol & licensing
sections.body: We serve responsibly. Our team are experienced and, where required, personal-licence holders. We will not serve anyone under 25 without valid ID, or anyone excessively intoxicated — this protects you, your guests and your venue.

sections.heading: On the day
sections.body: We need reasonable access for setup and breakdown, and a safe, level spot for the bar (we will confirm space and power needs with you in advance). Our equipment remains our property; accidental damage caused by guests may be charged at cost.

sections.heading: The boring-but-important bit
sections.body: The Bar People Ltd holds public liability insurance. Nothing in these terms affects your statutory rights. Any questions — jake@thebarpeople.co.uk and we will talk it through like humans.

terms_page.seo_description: The terms that apply when you book The Bar People for your event.
